Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Binance P2P LATAM Exclusive: Earn Up to 25% APR on USDC!
Start: 2026-11-17T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-17T23:59:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 500 USDC
Smallest threshold (parsed): 500 USDC (stake)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is launching a new promotion for new P2P LATAM users! Eligible participants who complete a crypto purchase via P2P Buy and subscribe to USDC Flexible Products during the Promotion Period can enjoy an exclusive 25% Special APR for seven days on top of Real-Time APR rewards.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-17 00:00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-17 23:59:59 (UTC)
## Eligibility
This promotion is exclusive for users who meet the following criteria:
Group A (New LATAM Earn Users): Users who have not used any Binance Earn products before 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC) and complete a crypto purchase via P2P Buy during the Promotion Period.
Group B (New LATAM P2P Users): LATAM users who have not traded in P2P prior to the Promotion Period and make a crypto purchase via P2P Buy during the Promotion Period.
Buy Crypto Now via P2P!
## How to Participate
Meet the eligibility mentioned above.
Within 5 to 10 minutes after making their deposit on P2P during the Promotion Period, qualified users will be able to enjoy a 7-day Special APR of 25% via one of the following methods, capped at 500 USDC per user:
Access One Click Buy & Earn on P2P to instantly earn.
Subscribe to Earn directly on USDC Flexible Products.
## Reward Structure
Digital Asset | Product | APR During Promotion | Min. Subscription Limit per User | Max. Subscription Limit per User
USDC | Flexible | Tier Range: ≤ 500 USDC | Tier Range: > 500 USDC | 0.01 USDC | Unlimited
Up to 25% | 3% （Approximately 3% Real-Time APR)
## Please note:
This 25% Special APR cannot be combined with other Bonus Tiered APR campaigns. Users may only participate in one Special APR campaign at a time.
The 25% Special APR reward is effective for 7 days from the subscription date and is only applicable to the 500 USDC subscribed to USDC Flexible Products. Any subscription amount exceeding 500 USDC will only earn Real-Time APR rewards.
It may take up to 10 minutes before eligible users can see and subscribe to the special offer.
The 7-day offer starts from the day that eligible users subscribe to USDC Flexible Products.
Subscription Format: Maximum seven (7) days of subscription period.* Complete subscription on a first-come, first-served basis in accordance with the terms below.
## Reward Payout:
Special APR: Distributed to users’ Spot Accounts on a daily basis. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription).
Real-Time APR: Accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
Enjoy Special APR Now!
## Terms & Conditions
This promotion is only available to users who are eligible for Binance Earn products in LATAM, and may not be available or may be restricted in certain jurisdictions or regions, or to certain users, depending on legal and regulatory requirements.
The products or features referred to above may not be available in users’ regions. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Only users who complete identity verification and meet one of the eligibility criteria above during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotion, and only master accounts qualify for rewards in the Promotion. Sub-accounts are not eligible to receive rewards.
Changes to the Binance Simple Earn Rewards Rate will be published on the Platform from time to time. Please refer to Binance Simple Earn Terms & Conditions and Risk Warning for more information prior to using Binance Simple Earn.
## APR Rewards:
Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for accurate information. Real-Time APR rewards are accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
This 25% Special APR is offered as an additional reward on top of Real-Time APR. This is calculated based on the subscribed amounts up to the cap of 500 USDC for this campaign. Upon subscription, the 25% Special APR rewards start to accrue the next day starting from 00:00 (UTC) based on the snapshot of the user’s subscribed amount to the Flexible Products of the day. This snapshot will be taken randomly between 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC) daily. Rewards will start to be distributed the following day after accrual starts between 00:00 (UTC) and 08:00 (UTC) to the user’s Spot Account.
Any redemption of Flexible Products made between 00:00:00 (UTC) and 00:00:00 (UTC) of the following day will stop the accrual of Special Tiered APR rewards on the redeemed amount for that day.
Redemptions of Flexible Products will be processed starting with assets that have accrued rewards. Users can check the rewards history from the Earn History.
This 25% Special APR reward is calculated based on the subscribed amounts and is subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to this FAQ for more details.
Eligible users who subscribe to USDC Simple Earn Flexible Products Special Offer will receive both Real-Time APR and Special APR rewards for up to 7 days for USDC during the Promotion Period.* Before the Promotion Period ends, users can enjoy the Special Offer within the 7-day period after the first subscription. Redemption within the 7-day period will terminate the reward accrual of the Special APR rewards from the redemption day. After the Promotion Period ends, users will only be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards.
Example: User A subscribes to USDC Flexible Products on 2026-11-17, redeems on 2026-11-20, and resubscribes on 2026-11-21. Special APR rewards will accrue on 2026-11-18, 2026-11-19, and 2026-11-22, and be distributed to User A on 2026-11-19, 2026-11-20, and 2026-11-23.
APR rewards are distributed from Binance’s own funds, and are determined based on the assessment and evaluation of prevailing market conditions. This Promotion is not associated with the issuer of USDC in any manner.
A large amount of redemption requests might delay redemption temporarily. Redemptions may resume upon return of liquidity.
Users can view their Flexible Products assets by going to Assets > Earn > Simple Earn.
Redemption time for Flexible Products subscriptions: Instant.
For more information on Binance Simple Earn, please refer to the FAQ.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
APR is a promotional reference rate used to estimate temporary rewards. It is not a yield, return, interest, or guaranteed profit; it implies no capital preservation and ensures no gain. Rewards come from Binance's own funds, are temporary, may be amended or cancelled, and do not originate from the issuer of USDC. Digital assets are volatile: you may not get back your investment. Not financial advice.
